rules.title: No !! on values that can be null
rules.body: Do not use the !! operator on values that can be null at runtime; handle the null case with ?:, let, or an early return.

rules.title: Structured concurrency only
rules.body: Never use GlobalScope. Coroutines run in a scope tied to a lifecycle (viewModelScope, a request scope, a supervisor owned by a component), and blocking calls run on Dispatchers.IO.

rules.title: Rethrow CancellationException
rules.body: Code that catches Exception or Throwable inside coroutines rethrows CancellationException, so cancellation keeps working.

rules.title: Immutable data classes for values
rules.body: Values passed between layers are data classes with val properties; changes are made with copy(), not by mutating shared instances.

rules.title: runCatching results are used
rules.body: The Result of runCatching is always handled (getOrElse, onFailure, fold); it is never ignored, which would swallow the error.
